paper.title_en: HVP contributions to the muon anomalous magnetic moment in spacelike and timelike domains
paper.abstract_en: The hadronic vacuum polarization contributions to the muon anomalous magnetic moment $a^{\text{HVP}}_μ$ in spacelike and timelike domains are recapped. The values of $a^{\text{HVP}}_μ$ assessed within dispersively-improved perturbation theory are reported. The obtained results can be employed in the evaluations of $a^{\text{HVP}}_μ$ in the framework of such methods as lattice studies, MUonE project, and others.
